name: Trend-day identification and hold
hypothesis: After 11:00, if price is in the top 10% of the day's range, has held above VWAP for 90% of bars and extended above the first hour, hold long to the close.

entry.long: tod() >= 660 and close > session().high - 0.1*(session().high - session().low) and count(close > vwap(), 18) >= 16 and session().high > opening_range(60).high
entry.short: tod() >= 660 and close < session().low + 0.1*(session().high - session().low) and count(close < vwap(), 18) >= 16 and session().low < opening_range(60).low
